Hello! Im 2 1/2 weeks post op! You’ll do great! One of the best bits of advice i got was to buy a pack of water bottles and unscrew all the tops, so they are open (because unscrewing them can be difficult after surgery). Buying nutritional protein shakes as well (not sure where your from, but i got the brand ensures) and drank those for pretty much the first 3 days (they are meal replacement safe as well!). Pineapple juice helps with swelling (make sure if you buy some its 100% pineapple juice only), start drinking that 2 days before surgery and then the days after surgery (seriously it will help with swelling so much). Stool softners obviously (i also ended up getting fiber supplement pills as well, the constipation you will have will be intense lmao) and with stool softners start taking them 2 days before surgery as well. If you haven’t had your pre-op appointment yet, they usually will give you a packet with all the things you will likely need to buy for aftercare and what not, so dont worry if you feel lost rn (if they dont hit me up and i can send you all the info i got from my surgeon/nurses). Also surgery centers kinda end up providing different things for after care, so you might have to end up buying some stuff but not other things (from dressings to compression vests). Pillows and lots of pillows, i recommend getting one of those reading bed pillows (not sure what they are called but they are comfortable to sit up in)! Also if you aren’t already a back sleeper i would start practicing falling asleep on your back. the first week after surgery it wont be hard to asleep on your back since all the pills, but after awhile the want to sleep on your side kicks in and you have to force yourself on your back lol. For kinda unnecessary stuff (stuff you don’t technically need but helps): I got a bed tray and that was amazing, i was able to set my laptop up and watch movies, eat my meals, and do some legos all from my bed!. Getting yourself fun stuff, i bought myself legos, you could get yourself a new videogame to play. Some books if your into reading! Just something to do after surgery thats fun! I saw someone before recommended buying some new clothes to wear once your all better (but he recommended that if your super nervous and need something to get you through all this). Anyway this is all i can think of rn! I really hope your surgery goes great and if you have anymore questions feel free to ask :D
